N1.s: Все %lld бесплатных мест заняты. Продолжите в приложении: после разблокировки этот Катлинг сохранится.
N1.back: All 5 free places occupied. Continue-(you, formal) in the-app: after unlocking this Catling will-save-itself.
N1.why: Opens with the slot wording of S3; «Продолжите в приложении» echoes the iOS «Продолжить в приложении» action, and saying «приложение» keeps «этот Катлинг» meaning only the item; 99 characters.

N2.s: Все %lld бесплатных мест заняты. Чтобы сохранять дальше, откройте и разблокируйте Катлинг.
N2.back: All 5 free places occupied. In-order-to save further, open and unlock Cutling.
N2.why: No item is named here, so the app can be called Катлинг, which a Shortcut reply on the Mac needs; two formal imperatives share one object, and «сохранять дальше» carries over S2's «и дальше»; 87 characters.

N3.why: Neuter impersonal «Сохранено», as iOS confirms a save in Russian; «место» is the keyboard's slot word from K1, and «одно» spelled out reads warmer than a digit; exactly 30 characters, no final stop, like K1.

N4.why: Same «Сохранено» opening as N3, then S5's count form «Занято … из …»; 5 of 5 tells the person they are full with no limit word; 29 characters.

N5.why: Fact, then the tap's action in the infinitive, as K1 does; «и сохранить» tells them the item they were saving is kept; «мест» dropped because the bar sits on the keyboard where N4 just said it; 41 characters, one over the Latin budget.

N6.why: Russian says «открыть» for unlocking content (открыть доступ, открыть уровень), and the tap does open Cutling to unlock; «Разблокировать» is 14 letters and does not fit 10, and «Купить» would promise a purchase the button does not make.

N7.s: Все %lld бесплатных мест заняты. Разблокируйте приложение, и этот Катлинг сохранится.
N7.back: All 5 free places occupied. Unlock-(you, formal) the-app, and this Catling will-save-itself.
N7.why: Imperative plus «и» plus a future result is how Russian says do this and that follows; «приложение» for the app so «этот Катлинг» is only the item on the form, as in N1; 82 characters.

N8.s: Этот Катлинг отложен и сохранится, когда вы откроете и разблокируете приложение.
N8.back: This Catling put-aside and will-save-itself, when you will-open and will-unlock the-app.
N8.why: «Отложен» is the shop word for an item held for a customer, so it is kept without promising it is saved yet; «Этот» marks the item, so the line cannot be read as the app being postponed; one sentence, exactly 80 characters.
